train_period_note: CogAlpha fitness metrics as stored in manifest (typically 2018-2021 for cogalpha ashare)
formula: range_pct = (high-low)/close; smooth_range = ewm(range_pct, span=10); vol_ratio = volume / rolling_mean(volume,25); smooth_vol = ewm(vol_ratio, span=15); direction = (close-open)/close; smooth_direction = ewm(direction, span=3); factor = smooth_range * smooth_vol * smooth_direction
